questions.question: When comparing AI tools, what is the most important rule?
choices: Run the exact same prompt in both tools
Compare tools based on marketing claims
questions.explanation: A fair comparison requires running the identical prompt across tools. Different prompts produce different outputs, making comparison meaningless.

questions.question: Your comparison.md document should include which sections?
choices: Just a list of tools used
questions.explanation: The quest requires four sections: Tool (which tools you used), Output (what each produced), Better (which was better), and Why (your reasoning).

questions.question: What does 'CALIBRATE YOUR TOOLS' mean?
choices: Always use the cheapest tool available
Know which tool is better for which job and why
Use only one tool for everything
questions.explanation: Different AI tools have different strengths. Calibrating your tools means understanding each tool's capabilities so you can choose the right one for each task.
